_note: Gate register (SPEC 'Gate register' and the gate tables of Streams 1-7). One entry per check. 'on_fail' is the level when the check fails; thresholds are in thresholds.json under the same id. 'phase' = the build phase that implements the check (SPEC 'Build sequence'). Plain text is what the gate report shows a non-coding reader.

checks.title: Run matches the pinned Merit contract
checks.plain: Every table and column Merit promises is present with the right type, and the contract version (when Merit stamps it) is the one this release accepts.

checks.title: Merit run's own checks passed
checks.plain: Merit's recon ties, the member-month fan-out differs from the life totals only by rounding, and Merit raised no Stop finding.

checks.title: Claims match rate (in scope)
checks.plain: Share of in-scope claims linked to a member, by count and amount. At or above 95% the run is used fully; 85-95% only for level benchmarks; below 85% it is rejected (D-2).

checks.title: No identifiers left
checks.plain: Only allowed columns remain after anonymisation, and a pattern scan finds no Emirates ID, e-mail or phone number.

checks.title: Anonymisation keeps every row and amount
checks.plain: Rows, life-years, premium and claims are the same before and after identifiers are removed.

checks.title: Not already in the pool
checks.plain: The same submission (same file hashes) has not been loaded before.

checks.title: Same cedant and valuation already present
checks.plain: A run for this cedant at this valuation date is already in the pool; replacing it needs a sign-off.

checks.title: Maturity of the latest UW year
checks.plain: Months of development since the latest UW year began, so readers know how immature the newest year is.

checks.title: Base tables tie to the snapshot
checks.plain: Life-years, earned premium, reported and ultimate claims in the analysis tables equal the pool snapshot.

checks.title: Basis declared
checks.plain: The submission states its premium basis (VAT, fees), claims basis (payer share, pre-adjudication) and fronted business.

checks.title: Unmapped values per factor
checks.plain: Share of exposure whose value is not in the pool vocabulary. Up to 2% passes, 2-10% is flagged, above 10% the factor is left out of models.

checks.title: Not Available values per factor
checks.plain: Share of exposure with no value for the factor (for example no date of birth).

checks.title: Submission looks unusual
checks.plain: Burning cost per life-year far from the pool on a robust scale. Reviewed by a person, never removed automatically.

checks.title: One cedant dominates a cell
checks.plain: One cedant holds more than half of a cell's exposure; the disclosure rule decides what a client may see.

checks.title: Immature months left out of calibration
checks.plain: Incurred months whose completion factor is below the maturity threshold are counted but not used to fit models.

checks.title: Cube ties to the base tables
checks.plain: Every benchmark total equals the analysis tables it was built from.

checks.title: Disclosure rule on every client-visible cell
checks.plain: Loss-cost cells: at least 3 cedants, none above 50%, 500 life-years. Premium and loss-ratio cells: 5 cedants, none above 25%, 1,000 life-years (D-4).

checks.title: Credibility shown on every cell
checks.plain: Each cell carries its credibility Z; below 0.3 it is replaced by its parent level, named beside it.

checks.title: Cell driven by one cedant
checks.plain: Leaving one cedant out moves the cell by more than 15%.

checks.title: Movement since the last version
checks.plain: A cell moved more than 20% since the previous published version without a recorded reason.

checks.title: Trend interval width
checks.plain: A trend whose 90% interval is wider than 10 points is labelled indicative.

checks.title: Plausibility ranges
checks.plain: Frequency, severity and loss ratio inside the ranges the owner set.

checks.title: Recovers planted synthetic effects
checks.plain: On synthetic data with known answers, the model finds them within its spec tolerance.

checks.title: Fit converged, no empty levels
checks.plain: The estimation converged and every factor level has at least 1% of exposure.

checks.title: Fitted totals balance to actual
checks.plain: On the training data the model reproduces the actual total within 0.1%.

checks.title: Shape plausible to an actuary
checks.plain: Signs and shapes make sense (for example cost rising with age). Network tiers are a monitoring dimension, not cost-ordered, so tier order is reported, not regrouped (D-1).

checks.title: One-way versus multivariate gaps explained
checks.plain: Where the model's relativity differs from the one-way table by more than 15%, a written reason is recorded.

checks.title: Relativities stable
checks.plain: Each relativity's 90% bootstrap interval is narrower than 20% of its value; otherwise the level is grouped.

checks.title: Out-of-time A/E
checks.plain: On the year the model never saw, actual over expected is between 0.95 and 1.05.

checks.title: A/E by credible factor level
checks.plain: For levels with credibility 0.5 or more, actual over expected is between 0.90 and 1.10.

checks.title: Out-of-cedant error
checks.plain: Predicting an insurer left out of the fit is no worse than using the pool average.

checks.title: Better ranking than today's method
checks.plain: Gini and double-lift are strictly better than the current one-way approach.

checks.title: Blend beats both extremes
checks.plain: The credibility-blended loss ratio errs less than pool-only and own-experience-only.

checks.title: Reserve range coverage
checks.plain: Between 80% and 97% of past run-offs fell inside the predicted 90% range.

checks.title: Documented and independently signed
checks.plain: Model card, inventory entry and the independent reviewer's sign-off are complete.

checks.title: Client data passed G1 and G2
checks.plain: The client's own data cleared the same ingest and comparability checks as the pool.

checks.title: Only released, current models
checks.plain: Every model used passed G5 and is not past its review date.

checks.title: Prior excludes the client
checks.plain: The market expectation was built without the client's own data, so nothing is counted twice.

checks.title: Inside the model's domain
checks.plain: At most 10% of the client's exposure sits in unmapped or low-credibility levels.

checks.title: Decomposition adds up
checks.plain: Pool expectation, client adjustment and large-loss load add up exactly to the result.

checks.title: Credibility weight consistent with size
checks.plain: Z is between 0 and 1, and a small client cannot receive near-full credibility.

checks.title: No other cedant exposed
checks.plain: Nothing below the disclosure rule about another cedant appears in the output.

checks.title: Interval and assumptions printed
checks.plain: The result shows its range, the pool version, model versions and any overrides.

checks.title: Every figure ties to an output table
checks.plain: Each number in the deliverable is found in the output tables it came from.

checks.title: Every figure has a badge and basis
checks.plain: Each figure carries its confidence badge (High / Medium / Low) and its basis.

checks.title: Narrative numbers are real
checks.plain: Every number in the written summary exists in the output tables.

checks.title: Disclosure re-checked on the final file
checks.plain: The finished file passes the disclosure rule again.

checks.title: Peer reviewed
checks.plain: A second actuary has signed the deliverable.
